value.quote: We had a steady leak around the old patio roof after the big rain in March and were worried it would turn into ceiling damage. A & J sorted the metal sheets and flashing, explained what had failed, and left the place tidy. It was a relief to have it dealt with properly before the next downpour.
value.author: Karen T.
value.service: Patio roof leak repair and flashing replacement

value.quote: Our shed roof in Portsmith needed new metal roofing after years of salt air and a few loose fixings. The crew turned up when they said they would, measured everything properly, and worked around our business hours so we could keep using the yard. Straightforward job, no fuss.
value.author: Mick R.

value.quote: We asked A & J to replace sections of roof sheeting and tidy up the ceiling cladding on our older Queenslander. I appreciated that they checked the edges, screws, and joins instead of just quoting the obvious bits. The finished work looks neat and the water now runs where it should.
value.author: Leanne P.
value.service: Roof sheeting and ceiling cladding repairs
